myanmarLabourMinistry.observation: The Ministry EPS opportunity page contains Manufacturing-related historical EPS materials alongside other sectors, but KEP has not captured a current 2026 Manufacturing-labelled recruitment notice from this page.

facts.employerSelectionPrinciple: Applicants receive a job call only if selected by an employer.

historicalManufacturingEvidence.warning: This proves a Myanmar Manufacturing EPS workflow existed, but it is a 2025 post-selection artifact and cannot create a 2026 Manufacturing Country Pack.

requiredEvidence: A direct official 2026 Myanmar notice or HRD Korea schedule/result artifact explicitly labelled Manufacturing.
The artifact must identify the current cycle/sector rather than reuse Agriculture/Livestock, Construction or Forestry.
Cycle-specific dates, fee and registration documents must remain unset until supported by the Manufacturing artifact.
prohibitedInference: Do not infer Manufacturing from the existence of historical Manufacturing rounds.
Do not infer Manufacturing from a country-level Point System or from other-sector 2026 schedules.
Do not reuse Agriculture/Livestock, Construction or Forestry dates, quotas, documents or fees.

requiredAll.rule: Evidence must come directly from HRD Korea EPS-TOPIK or Myanmar Ministry of Labour / official POEA channel.
The artifact must identify the current 2026 cycle rather than a historical cohort.
The artifact must explicitly identify Manufacturing; country-level Point System evidence is insufficient.
At least one direct recruitment, registration, schedule, skills/result or final-result artifact must be captured for the current Manufacturing cycle.

forbiddenAsPromotionProof: Agriculture/Livestock, Construction or Forestry dates, fees, quotas or documents.
Validity-extension, roster-extension or re-registration evidence for an older Manufacturing cohort.
Third-party summaries, mirrors, social reposts or search snippets without a directly reviewed official artifact.
A country-level Point System artifact whose public text does not explicitly identify Manufacturing.

currentReview.conclusion: No direct official 2026 Manufacturing-labelled recruitment, registration, schedule, skills/result or final-result artifact is captured. Route promotion remains blocked.

monitoring.rule: Any monitored source change requires review. A changed page never auto-promotes the route; promotion requires promotionGate.requiredAll to be satisfied and reviewed.
